accuracy.evidence: Correct magma (underground melted rock) vs lava (surface), vent/pipe, crater, eruption, ash as fine erupted rock — standard KS1/KS2 earth-science vocabulary.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets magma/lava swap, every-mountain-is-volcano, fire-only with no melted rock, and ash=shelf-dust in predictions, sort, mix, challenge why(), and adult notes.

lab_distinct.evidence: Lab is volcano cutaway with magma fill and lava eruption — distinct from fossil burial (flagfoss) and dinosaur deep-time (flagdino).

lab_teaches.evidence: Learner must show the pipe, fill magma, erupt lava, label crater and ash, and sort magma vs lava before confirmation text.

predictions.evidence: Wrong options (tall hill only; magma in the sky; lava as rain; every mountain erupts) are overturned by later tasks.

challenge_feedback.evidence: why() names tall/toy, sky/rain, never/dust, fridge/river, shelf/choc, and ice/toon slips specifically.

readability.evidence: Ages 5–7 wording: short kid lines; magma/lava/crater/ash defined with concrete cutaway actions.

no_filler.evidence: No delve/journey phrasing; each line teaches vent, magma, lava, crater, ash, or an eruption idea.

mobile.evidence: Large build/erupt/label buttons; sort and challenge stack usable at phone width.

accessibility.evidence: Build, magma, erupt, label, and sort steps expose lbtn twins; say() updates canvas aria-label; challenge uses aria-live status.
